title: Monster Meets Medusa
description: A large green one-eyed monster with horns and sharp teeth stands in an open wooden doorway labeled 'north #56', holding a film reel ticket while reaching toward a sad young woman whose hair consists of writhing green tentacles. The scene is set in a dark, rainy night with purple stormy skies, graffiti-covered walls featuring skulls and vibrant paint splatters.
